purpose: The ixazomib entries added in drug catalogue v2 (18 November 2026): names, mechanism, label warnings and interactions, written from the NINLARO label by the AI assistant. None feeds a calculation. Each item is one entry: check it against the label at the stated sections.
excluded: These entries are summaries, not quotes, so nothing was matched by script against the label text. “Matches” means the summary is faithful to the label at those sections.

decisions.matches: The value matches the source at the stated location.
decisions.wrong: The value does not match the source (note what the source says).
decisions.cannot_check: The source or location could not be checked.

items.label: warning: Low platelet counts

value.basis: The label describes thrombocytopenia with nadirs during each cycle and recovery by the next, and advises monthly platelet monitoring.

value.basis: The label describes diarrhea, constipation, nausea and vomiting, sometimes needing supportive medication.

items.label: interaction: Rifampin

value.title: Strong CYP3A inducer example
value.basis: The label describes decreased ixazomib exposure with rifampin and advises avoiding strong CYP3A inducers; rifampin is the studied example. Other class members named in the label are not separate references here.

items.how_stored: AI-written summary of the label at these sections, not a quote: check that it says what the label says; check the partner and the finding category

items.label: interaction: Clarithromycin

value.title: Clarithromycin studied context
value.basis: The label reports no clinically meaningful change in ixazomib exposure with clarithromycin, a strong CYP3A inhibitor. This finding does not establish general regimen compatibility or safety.
